label: Predictable amnesia defeats unrestricted future deference by explicit controls (inference)
rule: Explicit fair-report conditioning and squared-error comparison
meaning: In the same fair two-coin-world model, a world-revealing present report gives Heads conditional one or zero; a later erased report gives one half in both worlds. Conditioning now on both present knowledge and that known future one-half report preserves one or zero, while conditioning on the future report alone yields one half. The erased report cannot reconstruct the revealing report; the reverse reconstruction exists. Thus unrestricted future-credence deference fails in this explicit loss-of-information control even with each credence calculated by ordinary report conditioning. No claim of Beauty applicability follows. Proposed connection to epistemic warrant remains UNBUILT; reviewable synthesis in docs/notes/sleeping-beauty-1401.md.
